test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2024: Official Paper (Held On: 11 Jul, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2)**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The context suggests** that India will find organic farming appealing or favorable, thus making it an attractive proposal or proposition rather than a difficulty or hindrance.**
 
• **"Proposition" **is the most appropriate choice as it denotes a business idea or plan **that is likely to be beneficial or viable.**
 
• The other options, **"obstacle", "challenge", and "burden",** have negative connotations which do not fit the context of finding organic farming attractive.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2 (proposition)**.

 

***Correct Sentence**:* *"Organic agriculture offers a means to substitute costlier agricultural inputs such as HYV seeds, chemical fertilisers and pesticides with locally produced organic inputs that are cheaper and thereby generate good returns on investment. Organic agriculture also generates income through exports as the demand for organically grown crops is on a rise. Studies across countries have shown that organically grown food has more nutritional value than chemical farming, thus providing us with healthy foods. Since organic farming requires more labour input than conventional farming, India will find organic farming an attractive **proposition**."*
